note: Monk, front view. Head is the dark hair and full beard, bottom y~452 at the beard tip; the robe collar, brown robe, crossed lapel and dark sash, and the dark red cape behind the right hip are torso. Wide bell sleeves: no bend is drawn, so the elbow is halfway shoulder-to-wrist (y~525); the sleeve below it down to its diagonal opening is forearm, and the bare fists below are hands (left y606-690, right y606-685). Under the long robe the hip is the hem y~815 and covered thighs and lower legs get no label; only the bare ankle skin showing between hem and shoes (y815-831) is lower leg, and the dark shoes from y~831 are feet.
